title: Uncle Murda “Tonite” Feat. Dave East
htmlContent:
‘Tonite’ is motivational music.  If you got beef, meaning if you got an issue and you listen to this track somebody might get shot that night” Murda stated to Hotnewhiphop. “This ain't no squashing the beef music; this is aggressive music!  Dave East is my guy--- I told him I needed him on this, I sent him the record and he sent it right back!  Be on the lookout for the video; it’s coming soon!”

In a recent interview with Hot New Hip Hop Murda offered some clarity on his upcoming release plans “Don’t Come Outside- Volume 1- came around because I pushed my Lenny Grant project back after playing some music from 50 Cent. 50 wants to give it a bigger and better look when the time was right; that's how good the music is motherfuckers--its timeless music. So I resolved to put out Don’t Come Outside so GMG, ATM & The Unit can dictate policy on the streets and get y'all ready for what's about to come. Now for those of y'all that know me, yes, I'm talking crazy about this task. The content is really aggressive and I promise y'all won't be disappointed. Weirdoes are gone start getting smacked! Blame me for the crime rate going up but in a secure way! Don’t Come Outside is really entertaining! I got 50 Cent, Jadakiss, Young Dolph, Dave East, Maino, Don Q, Trick Trick on the project as well and we are also introducing y'all to some fresh talent that y'all need to get accustomed to. Hope y'all enjoy the new project for at least a week! If you live in a bad neighborhood and you not bout that life, trust me ni**s gone go upside ya head just because."

Pre-Order Uncle Murda’s Don’t Come Outside- Volume 1- at iTunes: https://itunes.apple.com/us/album/dont-come-outside-vol-1/1306256002&app=itunes
